subject: GrandView pricing alignment & onboarding exceptions
messages:
From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@grandview.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluating Redwood — pricing question vs EdgeServe

Hi Naomi,

Quick intro — I'm Lisa, CFO at GrandView Analytics. We're starting a vendor review for our real-time inference layer (current incumbent: EdgeServe). Procurement asked me to run a short RFP for price and operational comparability.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood match EdgeServe's blended unit price for our current committed usage (see attached current contract excerpt)?
- What migration support / one-time credits do you offer for a mid-year switch?
- Any onboarding exceptions (e.g., waive egress/egress credits, accelerated onboarding SLA)?

Attachments: GrandView_Current_Contract_2026.pdf (contract excerpt)

We'd like a proposal by next week if possible — team is targeting a June 1 cutover window. Happy to jump on a 30m call if that helps.

Thanks,
Lisa Park
CFO | GrandView Analytics
procurement@grandview.ai

---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@grandview.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluating Redwood — pricing question vs EdgeServe

Lisa — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the contract excerpt. We can put together a concise, itemized response and a firm offer for your June 1 target. Quick answers up front:

- Price match: we can consider matching EdgeServe's per-token blended rate for the first 6 months, subject to a 12-month committed capacity on the Redwood platform.
- Migration support: we typically provide a one-time migration credit (engineering hours / professional services) and a dedicated onboarding runway (SOW).
- Onboarding exceptions: we can offer a temporary egress credit for the first 90 days and an accelerated onboarding SLO with a focused migration team.

I'm attaching a preliminary worksheet so we can validate the numbers quickly — if you can confirm current monthly token volumes and peak qps we will finalize the matched-rate calculation.

Attachments: prelim-match-sheet.xlsx

Are you available Monday for a short 20m call to confirm volumes?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GrandView pricing alignment — approval request for concessions

Team — forwarding GrandView's ask (attached). They want a pricing match to EdgeServe plus migration/onboarding exceptions. Proposed commercial concessions to close by next week:

Proposal (pre-approval):
- Matched blended token rate for months 1–6.
- Requirement: 12-month committed capacity (month-to-month billing after commit).
- One-time migration credit equivalent to $60k in professional services for migration and integration validation.
- Waived egress charges for first 90 days.
- Accelerated onboarding SLA (2-week dedicated migration runway) with redwood engineering lead.

Attachments: cost-comparison.xlsx — shows P&L impact at current GV volumes.

Key risk: the 6-month matched pricing pulls forward margin; need to ensure committed capacity and a migration credit cap. Can we approve up to $60k PS credit and temporary egress waiver? If we go deeper (e.g., 9 months match or larger credit) we should route to sales leadership for exception.

Thanks,
Naomi

--- Forwarded message attached above ---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: GrandView pricing alignment — approval request for concessions

Naomi / Marissa —

I'm OK with the proposed concessions with the following conditions:
- Approve up to $60k migration credit, recorded as a one-time contra revenue line tied to deal GV-2027-05.
- Matched rate limited to first 6 months and gated on a signed 12-month commitment (minimum monthly committed spend to be defined on the final SOW).
- No permanent egress waiver — 90 days only, after which standard egress terms apply.
- Require a risk clause: if GV reduces committed capacity by >30% within the first 6 months, Redwood reserves the right to re-evaluate pricing retroactively.

If Marissa signs off on operational readiness (SOW/PS capacity), we can route the final offer to Lisa.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@grandview.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Formal offer: matched pricing + migration credits + onboarding plan

Lisa — thanks again for the call earlier today. Per our conversation and internal approvals, here's a concise offer we can put on paper immediately:

Offer summary:
- Price: Redwood will match EdgeServe's blended per-token rate for months 1–6 following cutover.
- Commitment: Signed 12-month committed capacity (monthly invoiced).
- Migration credit: $60,000 applied as a one-time professional services credit for integration, data validation, and live-test support.
- Egress credit: Waived for first 90 days post-cutover (applies to outbound transfer charges for data export during migration).
- Onboarding: 2-week dedicated migration runway with a named engineering lead; target cutover week: week of June 1.
- Risk guardrail: If GrandView reduces committed capacity by more than 30% in the first 6 months, Redwood reserves the right to retroactively re-evaluate matched pricing.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the above via quick reply.
2) I will send a short SOW (GV_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf) and a DocuSign link for signature.
3) Once signed, we'll schedule the onboarding kickoff and lock the migration engineering team.

Attachments: GV_Redwood_Offer_v1.pdf, GV_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf
Related: HubSpot HS-892134, DocuSign https://www.docusign.com/link/GV-REDWOOD-OFFER-892134

We appreciate the opportunity and will prioritize the June 1 window if you accept.

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126

Naomi — this looks straightforward and aligns with what we discussed. We accept the matched pricing under the conditions you listed. Two quick asks before signature:
1) Can you clarify the minimum monthly committed spend that will be recorded on the SOW? (we want to ensure the cap aligns to our forecasting)
2) Please include an explicit 5-business-day window for Redwood to provide the named migration lead after signature (we need to lock resources).

If you add those items to the SOW, we will route to legal and sign the DocuSign. Please send the updated SOW and final DocuSign link and we'll aim to sign by EOD Thursday.

Thanks,
Lisa Park
CFO | GrandView Analytics
procurement@grandview.ai
